title: New reject scenario's selection assert is vacuous: sel_node and sel_pipe are mutually exclusive, so the `&&` condition can never fire
evidence:
case "input_parity_reject":
		if r, ok := find(runs, devs, .Mouse); ok && r.sel_node != -1 && r.sel_pipe != -1 {
			append(fails, fmt.tprintf("  %s mouse: a rejected draw must not change the selection (sel pipe %d, node %d)",
				sc.name, r.sel_pipe, r.sel_node))
--- sibling assert one case up uses || (parity.odin:786):
	case "input_parity_pan":
		if r, ok := find(runs, devs, .Touch); ok && (r.drag_active || r.sel_pipe != -1 || r.sel_node != -1) {
--- the input package never sets both at once (exec.odin click_select):
		if inp.topo.node_kind[slot] == .Junction {
			inp.sel_node = i64(id)
			inp.sel_pipe = -1
			return
		}
...
	if pid, ok := pipe_hit(inp.topo, inp.cat, wx, wy); ok {
		inp.sel_pipe = i64(pid)
		inp.sel_node = -1
detail: click_select/right_click_select always clear one field when setting the other, so `sel_node != -1 && sel_pipe != -1` is unreachable — a regression where the rejected draw's release selects the endpoint (sel_node=2, sel_pipe=-1) passes the pin. The sibling pan assert uses `||`.
recommended_fix: Change `&&` to `||` (or two separate asserts) so the pin fires when either selection field changed.

title: ci-local.sh gate list not updated with the new input-parity CI step, breaking the repo's documented step-for-step local/CI mirror
evidence:
ci-local.sh header: "# The gate list mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml step-for-step — the workflow
# is the spec; never edit one without the other. Same order, same failure"
--- last GATES entry (line 62), no input-parity gate follows:
  "Stats stream replay-identity (live == replay)|tools/harness.sh stats-check pause && tools/harness.sh stats-check qos_contention"
--- the diff adds to ci.yml only:
+      - name: Input parity (T1 across inputs — mouse == touch == controller)
+        run: tools/harness.sh input-parity
detail: The diff edits the workflow without the mirror the file says must never be split: `tools/ci-local.sh` (the 'full local suite' the briefing requires green) silently skips input-parity, so a parity regression ships to CI red after a locally-green run.
recommended_fix: Append a gate entry like "Input parity (T1 across inputs)|tools/harness.sh input-parity" to GATES after the stats-check entry.

title: check_manifest's re-bless hint names `harness save <demo>`, which cannot bless the new parity goldens (no demos/input_parity_*.dem exists)
evidence:
append(fails, fmt.tprintf("T1: no manifest at %s (bless with `harness save %s`)",
		path, demo_name))
--- new caller (harness/parity.odin:723):
				check_manifest(sc.name, &demo, cat.hash, cat.balance.logic_hz, runs[0].hashes[:], &fails)
--- demos/ contains no input_parity_* file (ls demos | grep -i parity: no match); run_demo on that name fails at 'harness: cannot read demos/input_parity_draw.dem'
detail: Reusing the demo-manifest helper for non-demo goldens inherits guidance that points at a verb which errors for these names; the real re-bless path is `harness input-parity save`. Anyone following the hint after a catalog re-tune hits a parse error.
recommended_fix: Parameterize the bless-hint verb on check_manifest (or post-fix the message in run_input_parity) so parity goldens print `harness input-parity save`.

title: .memlog.md — an agent working-log artifact — is committed to the repo root as part of the story diff
evidence:
diff hunk (new file):
+---
+updated: 2026-08-16T11:11
+---
+
+- JOB 5.4 done-design: app/input intent layer (Device_Event -> Intent -> ONE executor), mouse transcription + touch/pad mappings, harness input-parity (11 scenarios), goldens input_parity_draw{,wide}.t1, CI gate. Review swarm fixes applied ... All gates green. Next: commit + PR.
--- `git log --all --oneline -- .memlog.md` shows only 2b875fb; `git cat-file -e origin/v2:.memlog.md` -> fatal: path '.memlog.md' exists on disk, but not in 'origin/v2'; no memlog entry in .gitignore
detail: Session bookkeeping ('Next: commit + PR'; stale '11 scenarios' vs 17) lands in the project tree, untracked by convention and ungitignored — every future story PR would accumulate or fight this per-minion state file at the repo root.
recommended_fix: Drop .memlog.md from the PR (or gitignore it); keep minion field-notes in the out-of-repo docs location the briefing names.
